usage: git [--version] [--help] [-C <path>] [-c <name>=<value>] <command> [<args>]

Main options:
  -C <path>             run as if git was started in <path> (may be given multiple times)
  -c <name>=<value>     pass a configuration parameter; can be used multiple times
  -L <n,m:file>         process the given line range; may be specified multiple times
  --config-env=<n>=<v>  like -c (repeatable)
  --tag TAGS            use an explicit tag list
  --exclude PATTERN...  exclude paths matching PATTERN
  -f, --filename=[]     files identifying the resource to use
  --exec-path[=<path>]  print or set the path to git-core programs
  --timeout SECONDS     abort the operation after SECONDS
  -v, --verbose...      increase verbosity (repeatable, takes no value)
  --color <WHEN>        when to colorize the output
